build_normalize_image_transform: build a python module to create a NormalizeImage transform that normalizes uint8 images using mean and std vectors
create_lookup_table_normalization: create a lookup table for fast image normalization by precomputing (pixel - mean) / std for all 256 uint8 values
generate_gpu_normalization_kernel: generate a CuPy elementwise kernel for GPU-accelerated image normalization using a precomputed lookup table
generate_cpu_normalization_code: generate CPU normalization code that applies per-pixel lookup table values to normalize image batches in parallel
declare_state_and_memory: declare the output state and memory allocation query for normalized images on CPU or GPU devices
